resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., PySCF, NWChem, ORCA)

access.notes: Must support B3LYP functional, effective core potentials, geometry optimization, and transition state search.

resources.name: Basis sets CEP-31G(d) for Si and 6-31G for H

access.notes: Includes the effective core potential for silicon. The basis set can be obtained from the Basis Set Exchange or is built into the DFT code.
